For many kids, school is one of the few places to get a healthy meal.

I have a bill included in the Healthy Meals, Healthy Kids Act that helps schools open food banks for families in need.
 
We'll keep working to strengthen federal nutrition programs & end child hunger for good.

Justin: What is Congress doing to protect Americans from COVID-19?

Rep. Castro: The Biden admin. has proposed and I support more funding for our nation's COVID-19 response. We also need more research to understand the impacts of long COVID and the potential treatment options.

Texas Republicans are forcing women to endure dangerous miscarriages without treatment.

Abortion bans are cruel and dangerous. Nobody should have to suffer like this.

Questions? Call 210-348-8216. https://t.co/FChNf0e7uq

Cancer is the leading cause of death among Latinos. Last year, @DrBiden & the Biden admin met with San Antonio's community to learn about disparities Latinos face with treatment and screening.

I will continue working with @POTUS to advance research and end cancer as we know it.

Thank you to the doctors, nurses, and medical staff at MD Anderson Cancer Center and the University of Texas Health Science Center San Antonio for their care and treatment, and thank you to my family for their love and support.

Prescription drugs cost too much.

Last year, I voted to pass the Inflation Reduction Act, which capped the cost of insulin at $35/month for seniors. Learn more about how you can switch to a Medicare plan with lower costs for diabetes treatment.👇

https://t.co/0kDJrzm6TI
Woman diagnosed with MS at age 24 puts spotlight on underrepresentation of Hispanics https://t.co/Cb5ZKmuUSq

My office was proud to join San Antonio’s Juneteenth Parade and Health & Wellness Fair to celebrate this historic holiday weekend and promote healthy living across our city. Thank you to everyone who came out! https://t.co/jISY0Wc9Nk

Cartels profit by meeting U.S. demand for drugs. To meaningfully fight fentanyl trafficking, we need more investments in addiction prevention + treatment.

In May, @HouseForeign passed my amendment expanding joint efforts to address youth drug use- a first step to curb demand. 2/

I could hardly pronounce “neuroendocrine” tumor, a rare form of cancer, when I got to MD Anderson in mid-July 2022.

But I knew that any tumor spreading across your body isn’t good.

I hadn’t told many people about my diagnosis even as so many things raced through my mind. 8/ https://t.co/jQLJD7Fo2J
@jillyrae82 Jill, I’m so sorry you’re about your diagnosis but wish you the best in your fight.

The insurance company negotiates down with the provider from $24K to $6.5K, covers that, and I pay $60 out of pocket monthly.

But millions of Americans have no insurance at all. Millions more don’t have enough. They can’t afford the treatment they need to fight off cancer! 13/

Through my cancer diagnosis, I’ve seen the costs of the American healthcare system firsthand - and I’m lucky enough to have insurance. No American should have to forgo the treatment they need to fight cancer because of the cost. https://t.co/u3xNFEAvmi

Joining @acosta on @cnn around 6 pm CT/7 pm ET with lots to discuss from TX & DC: the TX GOP’s acquittal of Ken Paxton, concerning reports about the treatment of asylum-seekers at the border, @GovAbbott’s Rio Grande death traps, extremist GOP demands in Congress & more.

These new allegations of contaminated surgical equipment at Brooke Army Medical Center (BAMC) are horrifying.

I'm demanding an explanation right now about BAMC's plan to fix this issue for good. BAMC treats thousands of patients a year and these failures put lives at risk.

In the wake of yesterday's @ExpressNews report about troubling failures with contaminated surgical equipment at Brooke Army Medical Center, I wrote to hospital leadership today, asking for answers on their plan to keep patients safe. Read my letter 👇
https://t.co/rs5IO9yjKM

#LetsTalkAboutNETs: Last year, I was diagnosed with neuroendocrine tumors, an uncommon cancer that’s on the rise. While my cancer was discovered accidentally, more than 50% of NETs patients are misdiagnosed for years, often with digestive issues. Awareness saves lives. @CureNETs https://t.co/qmskrRaJqW
